'''Vladlun's gang''' was a minor gang of criminals active on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The gang was led by [[Vladlun Travan]], a criminal involved in the kidnapping and murder of [[Felicia]], the daughter of [[Wernell Covington]], years before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the [[Narmle Militia]] was able to provide the last known location of Travan to Wernell Covington and the latter dispatched a spacer to [[Vladlun Travan's Hideout]]. The spacer fought and eliminated several gangsters during the attack. Covington's henchman eventually killed Vladlun Travan in the depths of the bunker, avenging the murder of Felicia Covington.<ref name="SWG:V" /> Around the same time, the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] also visited Vladlun Travan's Hideout to collect bounties for three criminals known to be associates of Travan: [[Titus Dabrini]], [[Aztin Maru]] and [[Tiaba Charr]]. However, Fett decided to let a spacer do his dirty work and take out the bounty targets.<ref name="SWG:BFTYTtW">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Boba Fett Throws You To the Wolves|Rori}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Vladlun's gang appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:V" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Vladlun's gang was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 12|Game Update 12]]," on [[August 10]], [[2009]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Game Update 12: Engineering Trader">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=976424|text=Game Update 12: Engineering Trader}}</ref>
